source.primary_witnesses: Aramaic DSS Astronomical-Book fragments (4Q208-4Q211; late 3rd c. BCE through late 1st c. BCE) where preserved; Ge'ez as fallback. NO continuous Greek witness for chs 72-82.
source.transliteration_convention: Aramaic Imperial-Aramaic per Milik 1976 + Tigchelaar-García Martínez DJD XXXVI 2000; Ge'ez SBL convention.
source.verificationStatus: best-effort reconstruction; verification pending against Milik 1976, Tigchelaar-García Martínez 2000, Drawnel 2011, Neugebauer 1985.
source.fetchedFrom: Milik 1976 + Tigchelaar-García Martínez 2000 DJD XXXVI + Drawnel 2011 + Black 1985 + Charles 1912 + Knibb 1978 + Nickelsburg-VanderKam 2012.
source.citation: Milik 1976; Tigchelaar-García Martínez 2000; Drawnel 2011; Black 1985 (with Neugebauer 1985); Charles 1912 PD; Knibb 1978; Nickelsburg-VanderKam 2012; VanderKam 1998.
source.paleography_note: CHAPTER 75 — THE FOUR LEADERS OF THE SEASONS (heads of 1000) + the 4 EPACT-DAYS added to the 360-day base to make 364. **THE 364-DAY-CALENDAR POLEMIC at its sharpest in the Astronomical Book** — explicit attack on those who 'do not reckon' the four extra days. Some 4Q209/4Q210 fragmentary material parallel.

verses.text_geez: ወአዕራግ፡ ርእሰ፡ ዕለታት፡ መርሖሙ፡ ዘበዐርብ፡ መንግሥቶሙ፡ ላዕለ፡ ዓለም፡ ላዕለ፡ ስብዓቱ፡ መንበራት፡ ለፀሐይ፡ መርሖሙ፡ ይትኬለልዎሙ፡ ወያስተሣዕልዎሙ፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾaʿrāg rəʾsa ʿəlatāt marḥomu zaba-ʿarb mangəśtomu lāʿla ʿālam lāʿla səbʿātu manbarāt la-ḍaḥay marḥomu yətkēlaləwwomu wa-yāstaśāʿəlwommu
verses.witness_secondary: Aramaic 4Q209 frag 25+26 may preserve fragmentary parallel (Drawnel 2011)
verses.notes: **Heads of the days, leaders of the four seasons, leaders of the stations of the sun — corrupted in the Ge'ez.** This verse names the four 'leaders' (marāḫət) of the year-quarters. **The four leaders are the angel-supervisors of the four EPACT-DAYS** that bring 360 → 364.

verses.text_geez: ወእልክቱ፡ አርባዕቱ፡ ዘዐሥርቱ፡ ምሥራቅ፡ ይትኬለሉ፡ መርሖሙ፡ በበ፡ ጊዜሆሙ፡ ወይቤለኒ፡ ዑርኤል፡ መልአክ፡ ዘውእቱ፡ መርሖሙ፡ ምክንያቶሙ፡ አርባዕተ፡ ዕለታት፡ ዘይትዌሰክ፡ ኢተሐስቡ፡ በውስተ፡ ኆለቅ፡ ለዓመት፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾəlləktu ʾarbāʿtu zaʿaśərtu məśrāq yətkēlalu marḥomu baba gizēhomu wa-yəbēlanī ʿUrʾēl malʾak zawəʾətu marḥomu məkənyātomu ʾarbāʿta ʿəlatāt zayətwēsak ʾitaḥasabu ba-wəsta ḫolaq la-ʿāmat
verses.notes: **THE FOUR EPACT-DAYS NOT-COUNTED — THE POLEMIC AT ITS SHARPEST.** 'Uriel says: these four days, ADDED [to make 364], ARE NOT RECKONED in the reckoning of the year [by the others — i.e. the lunar-calendar users].' **This is THE central polemical verse of the Qumran 364-day calendar tradition.** **CROSS-CORPUS**: cf. Jub 6:32-38 (the lunar-year-reckoners forget the 4 days + the 10-day gap, 'forgetting the new moons and seasons and sabbaths'). cf. MMT B (the Qumran community's identity-marker calendar polemic against the Jerusalem priesthood). Editor: handle as the central calendrical-identity claim.

verses.text_geez: ወይትዐጻዑ፡ በውስቴቶሙ፡ ሰብእ፡ ወይሰሐቱ፡ ኪያሁ፡ ፍጡነ፡ እስመ፡ እልክቱ፡ ብርሃናት፡ የአምሕሩ፡ ጊዜያተ፡ ለዓለም፡ በውስተ፡ መንበረ፡ ዓለም፡ አሐደ፡ በቀዳማይ፡ አንቀጽ፡ ወአሐደ፡ በሣልስ፡ ወአሐደ፡ በራብዕ፡ ወአሐደ፡ በሳድስ፡
verses.translit: wa-yətʿaḍāʿu ba-wəstētomu sabʾ wa-yəsaḥtu kiyāhu fəṭuna ʾəsma ʾəlləktu bərhānāt yāʾəmḥəru gizēyāta la-ʿālam ba-wəsta manbara ʿālam ʾaḥada ba-qadāmāyə ʾanqaḍ wa-ʾaḥada ba-śāləs wa-ʾaḥada ba-rābəʿ wa-ʾaḥada ba-sādəs
verses.notes: **HUMANS ERR by missing these days.** The four epact-days are anchored in gates 1, 3, 4, 6 (the solstitial and equinoctial gates — matching 1 En 72:10/26 [gates 6 and 4] and 72:16/20 [gates 3 and 1]). **The text explicitly states that those who omit the 4 days are in error.** Editor: the 'humans err' framing is the calendrical-polemic edge.

verses.text_geez: ወይትፌጸም፡ ድካም፡ ለዓመት፡ ፍጹመ፡ በውስተ፡ ሠለስቱ፡ ምእት፡ ስድሳ፡ ወአርባዕቱ፡ መንበራት፡
verses.translit: wa-yətfēṣam dəkām la-ʿāmat fəṣṣuma ba-wəsta śallastu məʾət sədsā wa-ʾarbāʿtu manbarāt
verses.notes: **364 'stations' = 364 days = the complete year.** Day = station; the schematic equivalence.

verses.text_geez: እስመ፡ ምክንያተ፡ ለዓለም፡ ይትገበሩ፡ ለሕገጊሁ፡ ለፀሐይ፡ ወለወርኅ፡ ወለከዋክብት፡ ወለኵሉ፡ ሐራ፡ ለዓለም፡ ዘፈጠረ፡ ዘበአስተራኩሞ፡ ይስተራኩሙ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ቀዋምት፡ ለዓለም፡
verses.translit: ʾəsma məkənyāta la-ʿālam yətgabbaru la-ḥəgagihu la-ḍaḥay wa-la-warḫ wa-la-kawākəbt wa-la-kwəlu ḥarā la-ʿālam zafaṭara zabaʾəstarākumo yəstarākumu kwəlomu qawāmt la-ʿālam
verses.notes: **The law of the sun, moon, stars governs the entire heavenly-host (kwəlu ḥarā — 'the host of the world').** Cross-corpus: Gen 2:1 ('all the host of them'); Isa 40:26 (counting the host of stars).

verses.text_geez: ወእንተ፡ ኮኑ፡ ስብዐቱ፡ መሣክወ፡ ዐበይተ፡ ዘፀሐይ፡ ወወርኅ፡ እምውስቴቱ፡ ይወፅእ፡ ብርሃኖሙ፡ ላዕለ፡ መንበራቲሆሙ፡ ስብዐ፡ ዘይትዐጻዑ፡ መንበራቲሆሙ፡ ወይትገብኡ፡ ኪያሆሙ፡ መሣክወ፡ ለበበ፡ ጊዜሁ፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾənta konu səbʿatu masākəwa ʿabayta zaḍaḥay wa-warḫ ʾəmwəstētu yəwaḍḍəʾ bərhānomu lāʿla manbarātihomu səbʿa zayətʿaḍāʿu manbarātihomu wa-yətgabbəʾu kiyāhomu masākəwa laba-gizēhu
verses.notes: **12 great windows** through which sun and moon emerge (the gate-windows of 1 En 72:5).

verses.text_geez: ወእምድኅረ፡ ኆለቅ፡ ዘስብዐቱ፡ መሣክው፡ ዘፀሐይ፡ ይትገብኡ፡ ለመሥራቅ፡ ወይዐርቡ፡ በውስቴቶሙ፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾəmdəḫra ḫolaq zasəbʿatu masākəw zaḍaḥay yətgabbəʾu la-maśrāq wa-yəʿarrəbu ba-wəstētomu
verses.notes: Sun returns through the windows to east and sets through them.

verses.text_geez: ወእምድኅረ፡ ሕገገዘ፡ ኆለቆሙ፡ ለከዋክብት፡ አርአየኒ፡ ቀዋምቶሙ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ወዐሥር፡ ወክልኤቱ፡ መንበራቲሆሙ፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾəmdəḫra ḥəgagaza ḫolaqomu la-kawākəbt ʾarʾayanī qawāmtomu kwəlomu wa-ʿaśr wa-kəlʾētu manbarātihomu
verses.notes: **THE 12 STATIONS OF THE STARS** — Uriel shows Enoch the stations of all the stars and their 12 places. **Cross-corpus**: the 12 stations = the 12 zodiacal divisions (Bavli sense: mazzālōt); cf. 2 Kings 23:5 (the mazzālōt as a class of astral bodies the Israelite reform attacked). The 12-station system is the framework underlying ch 76 (12 wind-gates) + ch 82 (12 monthly leaders).

verses.text_geez: ወአዕናቅፅ፡ ዘይወፅእ፡ እምውስቴቶሙ፡ ፀዓፋተ፡ መንፈስ፡ ኅሉቅ፡ ይከውን፡ በውስቴቶሙ፡ ኵሉ፡ መንፈስ፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾaʿnāqəḍ zayəwaḍḍəʾ ʾəmwəstētomu ḍaʿāfāta manfas ḫəluq yəkawwən ba-wəstētomu kwəlu manfas
verses.notes: **Sets up ch 76: the wind-gates.** Every wind (manfas) has its allotted gate.
